description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different emotional states in a study on speaker anonymization. There are six slices, each corresponding to a different emotion. The largest slice represents Frustration at 25.1%, followed by Neutral at 23.1%, Anger at 14.9%, Excitement at 14.1%, Sadness at 8.1%, and the smallest slice represents Happiness. Each slice is labeled with the name of the emotion and the corresponding percentage. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
